data.title: Super Playground Force Fun
data.description: Experiment with pushes and pulls to see how different objects move across surfaces!

challenges.instruction: What kind of push does the Toy Car need? Try it!
challenges.goalDescription: Move the Toy Car all the way across the wood floor.

challenges.instruction: What kind of push does the Barrel need? Try it!
challenges.goalDescription: Move the Barrel all the way across the carpet.

challenges.instruction: What kind of push does the Tennis Ball need? Try it!
challenges.goalDescription: Move the Tennis Ball all the way across the ice.

challenges.instruction: What kind of push does the Rock need? Try it!
challenges.goalDescription: Move the Rock all the way across the grass.
